info.title: Caliza API documentation reference
info.description:
The Caliza API enables seamless integration of financial services including payments, payouts, currency conversions, and compliance workflows. 

## Key Features
- **Transaction Management**: Create, simulate, and track financial transactions across multiple currencies and payment rails
- **Beneficiary Management**: Onboard and manage individuals and businesses with built-in KYC/KYB verification
- **Multi-Currency Support**: Handle USD, BRL, MXN, EUR, and cryptocurrencies (USDT, USDC) with real-time exchange rates
- **Payment Rails**: Support for ACH, Wire, PIX, SPEI, SWIFT, and blockchain networks (Ethereum, Polygon, Tron, Stellar, Base, Solana)
- **Compliance**: Automated KYX workflows, document verification, and regulatory compliance features
- **Webhooks**: Real-time event notifications for transaction status updates and system events

## Getting Started
1. Obtain your API credentials from the Caliza dashboard
2. Authenticate using Bearer token (JWT)
3. Create a simulation to preview transaction costs
4. Execute transactions using the simulation ID
5. Track status via webhooks or polling

## Base URLs
- **Sandbox**: `https://api.sandbox.caliza.com` - For testing and integration development
- **Production**: `https://api.caliza.com` - For live transactions

## Rate Limits
API requests are rate-limited to ensure system stability. Contact support for rate limit increases.

## Support
For technical support, integration questions, or API issues, contact our developer support team.

post.description: Creates a simulation to preview and calculate all costs associated with a transaction before executing it. For more detailed breakdowns, consider using the v2 simulation endpoint.

info.description:
The Caliza API enables seamless integration of financial services including payments, payouts, currency conversions, and compliance workflows. 

## Key Features
- **Transaction Management**: Create, simulate, and track financial transactions across multiple currencies and payment rails
- **Beneficiary Management**: Onboard and manage individuals and businesses with built-in KYC/KYB verification
- **Multi-Currency Support**: Handle USD, BRL, MXN, EUR, and cryptocurrencies (USDT, USDC) with real-time exchange rates
- **Payment Rails**: Support for ACH, Wire, PIX, SPEI, SWIFT, and blockchain networks (Ethereum, Polygon, Tron, Stellar, Base, Solana)
- **Compliance**: Automated KYX workflows, document verification, and regulatory compliance features
- **Webhooks**: Real-time event notifications for transaction status updates and system events

## Getting Started
1. Obtain your API credentials from the Caliza dashboard
2. Authenticate using Bearer token (JWT)
3. Create a simulation to preview transaction costs
4. Execute transactions using the simulation ID
5. Track status via webhooks or polling

## Base URLs
- **Sandbox**: `https://api.sandbox.caliza.com` - For testing and integration development
- **Production**: `https://api.caliza.com` - For live transactions

## Rate Limits
API requests are rate-limited to ensure system stability. Contact support for rate limit increases.

## Support
For technical support, integration questions, or API issues, contact our developer support team.

info.title: Caliza API documentation reference
info.description:
The Caliza API enables seamless integration of financial services including payments, payouts, currency conversions, and compliance workflows. 

## Key Features
- **Transaction Management**: Create, simulate, and track financial transactions across multiple currencies and payment rails
- **Beneficiary Management**: Onboard and manage individuals and businesses with built-in KYC/KYB verification
- **Multi-Currency Support**: Handle USD, BRL, MXN, EUR, and cryptocurrencies (USDT, USDC) with real-time exchange rates
- **Payment Rails**: Support for ACH, Wire, PIX, SPEI, SWIFT, and blockchain networks (Ethereum, Polygon, Tron, Stellar, Base, Solana)
- **Compliance**: Automated KYX workflows, document verification, and regulatory compliance features
- **Webhooks**: Real-time event notifications for transaction status updates and system events

## Getting Started
1. Obtain your API credentials from the Caliza dashboard
2. Authenticate using Bearer token (JWT)
3. Create a simulation to preview transaction costs
4. Execute transactions using the simulation ID
5. Track status via webhooks or polling

## Base URLs
- **Sandbox**: `https://api.sandbox.caliza.com` - For testing and integration development
- **Production**: `https://api.caliza.com` - For live transactions

## Rate Limits
API requests are rate-limited to ensure system stability. Contact support for rate limit increases.

## Support
For technical support, integration questions, or API issues, contact our developer support team.

info.title: Caliza API documentation reference
info.description:
The Caliza API enables seamless integration of financial services including payments, payouts, currency conversions, and compliance workflows. 

## Key Features
- **Transaction Management**: Create, simulate, and track financial transactions across multiple currencies and payment rails
- **Beneficiary Management**: Onboard and manage individuals and businesses with built-in KYC/KYB verification
- **Multi-Currency Support**: Handle USD, BRL, MXN, EUR, and cryptocurrencies (USDT, USDC) with real-time exchange rates
- **Payment Rails**: Support for ACH, Wire, PIX, SPEI, SWIFT, and blockchain networks (Ethereum, Polygon, Tron, Stellar, Base, Solana)
- **Compliance**: Automated KYX workflows, document verification, and regulatory compliance features
- **Webhooks**: Real-time event notifications for transaction status updates and system events

## Getting Started
1. Obtain your API credentials from the Caliza dashboard
2. Authenticate using Bearer token (JWT)
3. Create a simulation to preview transaction costs
4. Execute transactions using the simulation ID
5. Track status via webhooks or polling

## Base URLs
- **Sandbox**: `https://api.sandbox.caliza.com` - For testing and integration development
- **Production**: `https://api.caliza.com` - For live transactions

## Rate Limits
API requests are rate-limited to ensure system stability. Contact support for rate limit increases.

## Support
For technical support, integration questions, or API issues, contact our developer support team.

info.title: Caliza API documentation reference
info.description:
The Caliza API enables seamless integration of financial services including payments, payouts, currency conversions, and compliance workflows. 

## Key Features
- **Transaction Management**: Create, simulate, and track financial transactions across multiple currencies and payment rails
- **Beneficiary Management**: Onboard and manage individuals and businesses with built-in KYC/KYB verification
- **Multi-Currency Support**: Handle USD, BRL, MXN, EUR, and cryptocurrencies (USDT, USDC) with real-time exchange rates
- **Payment Rails**: Support for ACH, Wire, PIX, SPEI, SWIFT, and blockchain networks (Ethereum, Polygon, Tron, Stellar, Base, Solana)
- **Compliance**: Automated KYX workflows, document verification, and regulatory compliance features
- **Webhooks**: Real-time event notifications for transaction status updates and system events

## Getting Started
1. Obtain your API credentials from the Caliza dashboard
2. Authenticate using Bearer token (JWT)
3. Create a simulation to preview transaction costs
4. Execute transactions using the simulation ID
5. Track status via webhooks or polling

## Base URLs
- **Sandbox**: `https://api.sandbox.caliza.com` - For testing and integration development
- **Production**: `https://api.caliza.com` - For live transactions

## Rate Limits
API requests are rate-limited to ensure system stability. Contact support for rate limit increases.

## Support
For technical support, integration questions, or API issues, contact our developer support team.

info.description:
The Caliza API enables seamless integration of financial services including payments, payouts, currency conversions, and compliance workflows.

- **Transaction Management**: Create, simulate, and track financial transactions across multiple currencies and payment rails
- **Beneficiary Management**: Onboard and manage individuals and businesses with built-in KYC/KYB verification
- **Multi-Currency Support**: Handle USD, BRL, MXN, EUR, and cryptocurrencies (USDT, USDC) with real-time exchange rates
- **Payment Rails**: Support for ACH, Wire, PIX, SPEI, SWIFT, and blockchain networks (Ethereum, Polygon, Tron, Stellar, Base, Solana)
- **Compliance**: Automated KYX workflows, document verification, and regulatory compliance features
- **Webhooks**: Real-time event notifications for transaction status updates and system events

## Getting Started
1. Obtain your API credentials from the Caliza dashboard
2. Authenticate using Bearer token (JWT)
3. Create a simulation to preview transaction costs
4. Execute transactions using the simulation ID
5. Track status via webhooks or polling

## Base URLs
- **Sandbox**: `https://api.sandbox.caliza.com` - For testing and integration development
- **Production**: `https://api.caliza.com` - For live transactions

## Rate Limits
API requests are rate-limited to ensure system stability. Contact support for rate limit increases.

## Support
For technical support, integration questions, or API issues, contact our developer support team.
